facts.contactOnly: Self-serve frozen yogurt: pour it, top it, weigh it. Flavors rotate, so check their Instagram or come in to see what's on tap today. Ask the store about events, gift cards and fundraisers.

panels.head: Flavors & more
body: The Danville store is owned by the Chans, local Danville residents who opened it so families, friends and neighbors have somewhere to come together over a simple, joyful treat.
